findings.owner: WP10 composition, consuming WP11 published historical readers
findings.title: Host does not compose ledger-bound historical calculation readers after case advancement
findings.cause: withCase still calls cases.read. That reader includes ledger evidence and requires each ref to resolve fresh/historical. The WP10 calculation adapter always issues through requests.read and results.readForCalculation; the ordinary producer requires current.case.version === stored.caseRef.version. After acceptance advances v1 to v2 while retaining the C17 reference in the ledger, that ordinary reader refuses and cases.read becomes unavailable before lifecycle reentry. Published readHistoricalCalculation/readHistorical accept an exact current case/event/reference association, but WP10 does not compose them; its verifyCalculationSources wrapper also binds stored.caseRef to an exact-current withCalculationCase.
findings.impact: The current case and its retained calculation evidence cannot be reopened through the real host after a legitimate advance. Stale lifecycle reentry for that case also fails before the action, even though the new helper works for an empty-evidence case. This is a safe refusal and availability/functional gap, not evidence of leaked data or fresh authorization bypass.
findings.proofBasis: Exact published source causal chain, plus explicit owner test which expects current readers to reject and explicit historical lane to reopen the case after analysis acceptance. No local product execution or observed hosted reproduction claimed.
findings.requiredCorrection: Compose the published historical result/request readers in a private authorized host lane derived from a real current case and retained exact ledger event/reference. Preserve old result/source/provenance bytes, canonical replay, current authority and BCS projection/currentRef/differences/continuity requirements. Leave ordinary fresh read/selection/publication strict.
findings.prohibitedShortcut: Do not copy the WP11 fixture resolver as BCS implementation: it omits fields/continuity required by the production BCS. Do not mark historical calculation fresh or loosen version equality globally.
requiredProof: Hosted real WP10 BusinessServices + C08: persist a canonical calculation at v1, accept its exact ref into a real ledger event and advance the case to v2, then reopen cases.read and the historical evidence through the host.

Ordinary result/request/fresh-selection paths must still deny old case version; historical resolution must retain exact immutable request/result/source identity and expose current authorized differences.
Exercise the production run reentry through markStale/preserveStale with relevant real C08/historical sources; no fabricated native acceptance.
Missing/wrong ledger event, changed reference, new case incarnation, source/access revocation and mutation during awaited verification deny without leaks.
Bound nested/self references and verify no recursive cases.read cycle, permission cache reuse or old scope borrowing.
